evidence.detail: The exact class-file concat constant is literally 'WorldPoint(x=..., y=..., plane=...)'.
The class stores immutable x, y and plane, supports x/y/plane offsets, distance on matching plane and region/tile component extraction.
Factories convert from LocalPoint by shifting local coordinates by 7 and adding Client world base coordinates, with the active Client plane.
Its scene-membership helpers compare world x/y against the current 104x104 client base and its active-plane predicate checks Client plane equality.

proposals.note: Exact-v308 world-coordinate point; the class literal itself preserves the WorldPoint noun.

evidence.detail: The class stores two local coordinates constrained to 0 <= x,y < 13312, exactly the 104-tile scene span at 128 local units per tile.
Factory a(tileX,tileY) converts tile coordinates to local-unit centers with (tile << 7) + 64.
Factory b(worldX,worldY) first requires the world tile to be inside the client's current 104x104 scene, subtracts Client baseX/baseY and then converts the resulting scene tile to local units.
Conversion from rs/runelite/a/p rejects mismatched plane and otherwise converts that WorldPoint x/y through the same current-scene path.

proposals.note: Exact-v308 local scene-coordinate point; the role is proven by 128-unit scale and WorldPoint/base conversion.
